data.content: Which pairs of substances have the highest co-driver frequency (via JOINT_DRIVER_WITH relationship `frequency`), and do those substances also tend to be detected at the same sites?

args.query: List all JOINT_DRIVER_WITH relationships between pairs of substances, with their `frequency`, sorted descending. Then identify the maximum `frequency` value and return only the pair(s) that have this maximum. For each of these top pair(s), also report site co-detection statistics based on measured records: - number of distinct sampling sites where substance A was detected (defined as median_concentration > 0 at any time), - number of distinct sampling sites where substance B was detected (median_concentration > 0 at any time), - number of distinct sampling sites where both A and B were detected (at the same site, at any time), and - the co-detection overlap percentage = 100 * (co-detected sites) / (size of the union of detected sites for A and B). Return a concise table with: substance_A, substance_B, joint_driver_frequency, detected_sites_A, detected_sites_B, co_detected_sites, co_detection_overlap_percent.

args.query: Identify the JOINT_DRIVER_WITH pair(s) with the maximum frequency, then compute co-detection at sites. Detection is defined as any measurement record with median_concentration > 0 at any time. For each top-frequency pair, return: substance_A, substance_B, joint_driver_frequency, detected_sites_A (count of distinct sites with A detected), detected_sites_B (count of distinct sites with B detected), co_detected_sites (count of distinct sites where both A and B were detected), and co_detection_overlap_percent = 100.0 * co_detected_sites / size of the union of detected sites (A ∪ B).

            ``` 
            MATCH (a:Substance)-[j:JOINT_DRIVER_WITH]-(b:Substance)
WHERE a <> b AND a.Name < b.Name
WITH a, b, max(j.frequency) AS freq
WITH collect({a: a, b: b, freq: freq}) AS pairs, max(freq) AS maxFreq
UNWIND [p IN pairs WHERE p.freq = maxFreq] AS top
WITH top.a AS a, top.b AS b, top.freq AS freq
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[ma:MEASURED_AT]->(sa:Site)
WHERE ma.median_concentration > 0
WITH a, b, freq, collect(DISTINCT sa.name) AS sitesA
OPTIONAL MATCH (b)-[mb:MEASURED_AT]->(sb:Site)
WHERE mb.median_concentration > 0
WITH a, b, freq, sitesA, collect(DISTINCT sb.name) AS sitesB
WITH a, b, freq, sitesA, sitesB, [x IN sitesA WHERE x IN sitesB] AS interSites
WITH a, b, freq, sitesA, sitesB, interSites,
     (size(sitesA) + size(sitesB) - size(interSites)) AS unionCount
RETURN
  a.Name AS substance_A,
  b.Name AS substance_B,
  freq AS joint_driver_frequency,
  size(sitesA) AS detected_sites_A,
  size(sitesB) AS detected_sites_B,
  size(interSites) AS co_detected_sites,
  CASE WHEN unionCount > 0 THEN 100.0 * size(interSites) / unionCount ELSE 0.0 END AS co_detection_overlap_percent
ORDER BY substance_A, substance_B
            ```

data.content:
Here’s what the graph shows.

Top co-driver pair
- Methoxychlor — Terbutylazine with JOINT_DRIVER_WITH frequency = 53 (highest observed)

Do they co-occur at the same sites (detection defined as median_concentration > 0 at any time)?
- Methoxychlor detected at 17 distinct sites
- Terbutylazine detected at 2,846 distinct sites
- Co-detected at 14 distinct sites
- Overlap (union-based) = 0.49%
- Note: While the union-based overlap is very low (driven by Terbutylazine’s very broad detection), 82% of Methoxychlor detections (14/17) are at sites where Terbutylazine is also detected.

Reproduce the results with Cypher
// 1) List all JOINT_DRIVER_WITH pairs with their frequency, sorted descending
MATCH (a:Substance)-[j:JOINT_DRIVER_WITH]-(b:Substance)
WHERE a.DTXSID < b.DTXSID
RETURN a.Name AS substance_A,
       b.Name AS substance_B,
       j.frequency AS joint_driver_frequency
ORDER BY joint_driver_frequency DESC, substance_A, substance_B

// 2) Get the top-frequency pair(s) and their site co-detection stats (median_concentration > 0)
MATCH (a:Substance)-[j:JOINT_DRIVER_WITH]-(b:Substance)
WHERE a <> b AND a.Name < b.Name
WITH a, b, max(j.frequency) AS freq
WITH collect({a: a, b: b, freq: freq}) AS pairs, max(freq) AS maxFreq
UNWIND [p IN pairs WHERE p.freq = maxFreq] AS top
WITH top.a AS a, top.b AS b, top.freq AS freq
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[ma:MEASURED_AT]->(sa:Site)
WHERE ma.median_concentration > 0
WITH a, b, freq, collect(DISTINCT sa.name) AS sitesA
OPTIONAL MATCH (b)-[mb:MEASURED_AT]->(sb:Site)
WHERE mb.median_concentration > 0
WITH a, b, freq, sitesA, collect(DISTINCT sb.name) AS sitesB
WITH a, b, freq, sitesA, sitesB, [x IN sitesA WHERE x IN sitesB] AS interSites
WITH a, b, freq, sitesA, sitesB, interSites,
     (size(sitesA) + size(sitesB) - size(interSites)) AS unionCount
RETURN
  a.Name AS substance_A,
  b.Name AS substance_B,
  freq AS joint_driver_frequency,
  size(sitesA) AS detected_sites_A,
  size(sitesB) AS detected_sites_B,
  size(interSites) AS co_detected_sites,
  CASE WHEN unionCount > 0 THEN 100.0 * size(interSites) / unionCount ELSE 0.0 END AS co_detection_overlap_percent
ORDER BY substance_A, substance_B
